Anya Patel: Hey team — noticed over the weekend a customer bulk-upload (batch of 400 embedding requests) but their free-trial credits didn't decrement. They reported the API returned 200 for most items but the dashboard shows 0 token usage. request_id: req_7b9c2f. Any quick checks?

Kevin M.: Sorry to hear that, can you paste the exact request payload and the response headers for one of the items? Also which SDK / retry strategy were they using?

Anya Patel: They used our python SDK (v0.18), with client.embed_batch(..., chunk_size=50) and exponential retries enabled. Minimal repro: POST /v1/embeddings body ~ 8K tokens combined. Example response headers: ``x-request-id: req_7b9c2f`` ``x-rate-limit: 250`` ``content-length: 512`` Body is 200 with embeddings array.

Jordan (Billing): I pulled ledger entries for that customer around that time. There are idempotent_attempt records but the final debit didn't post. Looks like there were 400 attempted debits with status "pending_finalize" and then an out-of-order finalize never came. Ledger trace: ``ledger_txn: LTX-20260309-9921``.

Mira L.: That sounds like the client never sent the finalize/commit event after multipart batching. We recently changed the SDK to auto-flush on program exit but only if the process exits cleanly. Do we have logs for process shutdown?

Anya Patel: They ran the job inside a k8s cronjob that gets SIGTERM, then k8s kills after 10s. The customer says they saw a lot of 200s in the app logs and then pod restart. I can share the pod logs snippet.

Anya Patel: ```
2026-03-09T02:48:10Z INFO embedding_batch 200 items processed req=7b9c2f
2026-03-09T02:48:12Z WARN received SIGTERM, flushing buffers
2026-03-09T02:48:21Z ERROR flush incomplete, exit(0)
```

Kevin M.: That matches an incomplete finalize. Billing expects a finalize webhook/commit call to close pending debits. If the SDK didn't complete the flush before termination, ledger kept entries as temp and never applied final charges.

Jordan (Billing): I'm marking these entries for manual reconciliation but need a reliable repro to avoid manual credits. Can engineering confirm whether the SDK uses at-least-once finalization and how idempotency keys are used across chunk/retry?

Mira L.: SDK uses client-side batching + idempotency key per batch (X-Idempotency-Key). For retries we reuse the same idempotency key; but if the process restarts and a new key is generated, the ledger will keep pending records for the first key until finalize. Two actionable bugs: 1) flush-on-sigterm is flaky, 2) server finalizer requires explicit commit request we added last year.

Kevin M.: Proposed immediate remediation: (1) Billing to credit affected trial customers for the missing deduction and mark LTX-20260309-9921 resolved; (2) Support to share a small diagnostic script for customers to detect pending_finalize states; (3) Eng patch to make SDK flush synchronous on SIGTERM and to send commit while retrying on process exit.

Jordan (Billing): I can apply credits for the impacted accounts. Send me the list of customer ids + req ids. I'll also open a ticket to adjust ledger TTL for pending_finalize to auto-expire after 24h if finalize never arrives.

Anya Patel: I'll DM the customer ids now and attach the pod logs. Also adding a short KB: "Why my trial credit didn't change after bulk embedding". Thanks y'all. :pray:
